class.name: JRPGEntry
class.brief_description: One record of a JRPG database table.
class.description: Base class of every JRPG database record (actors, classes, skills, items...). An entry lives in a [JRPGTable], which assigns its [member id] from its position: the first entry has ID 1, the second ID 2, and so on. IDs never move, so other data can refer to an entry by its ID. Typed entries (for example the item data of a game) extend this class with their own properties.

method.name: assign_from
method.description: Copies every stored property of [param source] into this entry in place. The entry keeps its ID and its scene-unique id, and arrays and dictionaries are copied rather than shared, so later edits to either entry never affect the other. [param source] must be another entry of the same class. The database editor uses this to paste an entry and to undo a paste or a clear.

method.name: get_kind
method.description: Returns the kind of this entry, derived from its class: [code]"Item"[/code] for an item data class, [code]"Entry"[/code] for a plain [JRPGEntry]. Tables use it to name saved entries ([code]Item_42[/code]) and translation keys ([code]Item_42.name[/code]).

method.name: kind_from_class
method.description: Returns the kind for the class name [param class_name]: the name without its [code]JRPG[/code] prefix and [code]Data[/code] suffix.

method.name: reset_to_defaults
method.description: Resets every stored property of this entry to its default value. The entry keeps its ID; this is how an entry is "deleted" from a table without moving the IDs after it.

members.member: The entry's ID: its position in the owning [JRPGTable] plus one, or [code]0[/code] when the entry is not in a table. Assigned by the table and never saved.
The entry's name as shown to players and in the editor. It is translated through the key [code]<Kind>_<id>.name[/code].
Free text for designers and plugins. Tags written as [code]<tag:value>[/code] can be read by scripts.
